plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official Case Western Reserve University General Bulletin (2026-27) 'Biology' BA 'Sample Plan of Study' grid (https://bulletin.case.edu/arts-sciences/biology/biology-ba/). Footnotes: 'a': Unified General Education Requirement. 'b': Fulfills UGER Disciplinary Communication course requirement. 'c': Can count as an elective or a laboratory course, not both. 'd': Excluding BIOL 388, BIOL 388S, and BIOL 390. 'e': Excluding 100-level courses, BIOL 202, and BIOL 390. CREDIT RANGES: Year 3 Fall: 'ELECTIVE-4' printed 2-4; modeled at 2 per official term total 15. Year 3 Spring: 'ELECTIVE-8' printed 2-4; modeled at 2 per official term total 15. 'or' rows are modeled per convention with choice:true, first option as code, and all options in options[]. Rows combining lecture+lab (e.g. 'EBME 306 & EBME 356') are kept as one combined course with the official combined credit total. Unlabeled credit slots are elective choice placeholders. Prerequisites are not printed in the sample plan, so prereq arrays are empty; prerequisites live in the bulletin's course descriptions.
